audit_items.proof_trace: All four `withdrawRaisedCapital` implementations follow checks-effects-interactions: the withdrawal guard (either `capitalWithdrawn == true` revert in LegionAbstractSale/PreLiquidOpenApplication, or `totalCapitalWithdrawn > 0` revert in PreLiquidApproved/CapitalRaise) is checked first, then the flag/counter is set before any external transfer. The `cancel()` path that resets `totalCapitalWithdrawn` simultaneously sets `isCanceled = true`, and `withdrawRaisedCapital` carries a `whenSaleNotCanceled` modifier, preventing any cancel-then-replay attack.
